message.text:
memo_service_webhooks.go defines three dispatch functions: DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook, DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook, and DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook. They emit memos.memo.created, memos.memo.updated, and memos.memo.deleted respectively.

DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook emits memos.memo.comment.created. All three memo lifecycle dispatchers converge on dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook, which calls webhook.PostAsync. That helper lives in internal/webhook/webhook.go and invokes Post. Comment creation also calls webhook.PostAsync directly.

Four memo lifecycle events dispatch webhooks:

- created: DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook
- updated: DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook
- deleted: DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook
- comment created: DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook

The delivery function path is still being identified.

All four webhooks converge on `webhook.PostAsync` in `internal/webhook/webhook.go`. That function queues the HTTP call via `Post`. Created, updated, and deleted memos pass through `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` first. Comments go straight to `PostAsync`.

webhook.PostAsync — internal/webhook/webhook.go

The four dispatchers live in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go`. Create/update/delete go through `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook`; comment-created posts on its own. Both paths call `webhook.PostAsync`, which queues `webhook.Post` for HTTP delivery. Call sites: `memo_service.go` (create/delete), `memo_update_helpers.go` (update), `memo_service_comments.go` (comment).
